# OpenAI artwork

These SVGs are unchanged official OpenAI Blossom artwork from
https://cdn.openai.com/brand/OpenAI-Logos-2025.zip, retrieved 17 September 2026.

- `monoblossom-white.svg`: `OpenAI-logos(new)/SVGs/OpenAI-white-monoblossom.svg`
- `monoblossom-black.svg`: `OpenAI-logos(new)/SVGs/OpenAI-black-monoblossom.svg`

Used only to identify the ChatGPT sign-in connection, under the OpenAI brand
guidelines: https://openai.com/brand/. OpenAI retains its trademark rights.
The surrounding button is Case Forge's integration UI, not a claim of OpenAI
endorsement or a separately supplied official button component.
